description: Talon, the lone survivor of the Blackbloods, reaches a remote fortress in search of her family's killers and becomes entangled with Gwynn, Garret, Janzo, the Prime Order and the supernatural power hidden in her heritage.

s01e01.description: Talon, the last known Blackblood, reaches the remote Outpost while hunting the men who destroyed her people and finally confronts one of her family's killers.

s01e02.description: A mysterious rescuer reveals more about Talon's heritage as Marshal Wythers hunts the killer of a Prime Order officer and threatens anyone who stands in his way.

s01e03.description: Talon struggles to control the creature she summoned while Garret and Janzo investigate the spreading plague and Talon's friendship with Gwynn begins to deepen.

s01e04.description: Talon ignores warnings and pursues the demon before she is ready, while the Mistress moves ruthlessly to seize control of the Outpost's colipsum trade.

s01e05.description: Wythers uses a dangerous secret to blackmail Gwynn into surrendering Talon just as several killers from Talon's past arrive to finish old business.

s01e06.description: Talon commits to finding the legendary Book of Names, Gwynn's identity comes into the open and Janzo leads an expedition toward the source of the colipsum trade.

s01e07.description: Gwynn's suspicions of Wythers intensify while Talon and Janzo finally meet the mysterious colipsum suppliers and Garret conceals a worsening condition.

s01e08.description: Talon, Janzo and Garret cross into forbidden territory in search of the Book of Names as an army closes in on the Outpost.

s01e09.description: An ambush costs Talon and her companions the Book of Names while the Prime Order tightens its grip on the Outpost and Gwynn falls into new danger.

s01e10.description: Talon, Garret and Janzo return from the Greyskin wastelands to an occupied Outpost, forcing Talon to choose between revenge on Dred and saving her friends.
